description.value: Otter Co-op is a member-owned cooperative with deep roots across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley, operating food, fuel, pharmacy, feed, and liquor divisions under one roof. The co-op's wide regional footprint — spanning communities from Aldergrove and Langley to Chilliwack and Penticton — makes individual locations potentially useful resupply stops on several popular cycling corridors. Its 'Highwayman' brand suggests at least some locations are oriented toward road travellers.
